create_GCWrapper: create a GCWrapper instance with a simulator class, description dict, number of games, batch size, and T parameter
run_GCWrapper_Run: run the GCWrapper main loop that retrieves batches from the queue and dispatches them to registered callbacks
register_callback_GCWrapper_reg_callback: register a callback function keyed by name to process CPU and GPU batch data in GCWrapper
create_Collector: create a Collector with a ZMQ receiver, exponential operation, batch assembler, replier, and memory receiver
review_GCWrapper_collectors: review how GCWrapper initializes a list of Collector instances from the description dict connector entries
